process_area.title: Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics

fields.Participants: Contingent Workforce Mgr, User Dept, Procurement (links to VS-34/VS-67), Finance, Agency

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile scorecard per contractor" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document and follow up" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Drive performance into contract decisions" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: balanced scorecard and audit; operational: constructive QBR approach
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-manipulation risk**: Contractor games KPIs; mitigated by balanced scorecard and audit
- **Relationship deterioration**: Punitive scorecard use damages partnership; mitigated by constructive QBR approach
System Touchpoints: - Scorecard/BI (links to VS-28/VS-67); procurement (links to VS-34); contract (W3213)

steps.activity: Contingent Workforce Mgr/Procurement compile scorecard per contractor: SLA/KPI performance (W3212), quality audit scores, coverage/reliability (W3220), HSE (W3219/W3228), compliance attestations (W3210/W3226), invoice accuracy (W3221), customer/user satisfaction

Conduct quarterly business review (QBR) with each contractor: present scorecard, discuss improvement actions, credit/penalty application (W3212), recognition for top performers, improvement plans for underperformers, forward demand (W3209); document and follow up

Drive performance into contract decisions: feed scorecard into renewal/re-bid (W3216), preferred-supplier status, vendor master (links to VS-67/VS-03.3 vendor scorecard methodology), and category strategy (W3209)

fields.Participants: Labor Compliance Mgr, Legal, HR (links to VS-84), Internal Audit (links to VS-21), Contingent Workforce Mgr
fields.Trigger: Annual compliance audit; DOLE inspection/notice; worker regularization complaint

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review agency DOLE/SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG remittance evidence, wage-order…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track to closure" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documentation, supervisor-training evidence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: annual audit and structuring discipline (W3211); operational: remittance verification and indemnity recovery
Pain Points / Risks: - **DOLE-finding risk**: Labor-only-contracting finding → mass regularization and back-pay; mitigated by annual audit and structuring discipline (W3211)
- **Solidary-liability realization**: BuildRight pays agency's unpaid obligations; mitigated by remittance verification and indemnity recovery
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/audit (links to VS-21/VS-22); legal matter (links to VS-100); payroll (links to VS-19.2); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Labor Compliance/Internal Audit (links to VS-21) conduct periodic misclassification audit: sample engagements, apply four-fold test (W3215), review agency DOLE/SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG remittance evidence, wage-order compliance, contract terms vs actual practice; identify risk-rated findings
Remediate findings: convert confirmed employees (W3230), restructure engagements (W3211), strengthen supervisor training, recover solidary exposure where possible; track to closure

On DOLE inspection or NLRC complaint (links to VS-84.2/VS-100), defend: produce contracts, agency licenses/remittance proof, classification rationale, four-fold-test documentation, supervisor-training evidence; manage conciliation/settlement per VS-84.2 DOLE process; reserve for loss (links to VS-100 W3277)

fields.Participants: Contingent Workforce Mgr, Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-34.3), Procurement, User Depts

workflows.name: Contingent Workforce Spend Analytics & Cost Control

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "Finance/Contingent Workforce Mgr compile spend analytics" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "Analyze drivers and opportunities" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track savings vs target and report to finance/exec" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: PO gating and analytics visibility; operational: demand planning (W3209) and monthly tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Maverick-spend risk**: Off-contract engagements inflate cost and compliance risk; mitigated by PO gating and analytics visibility
- **Budget-overrun risk**: Unplanned contingent usage exceeds budget; mitigated by demand planning (W3209) and monthly tracking
System Touchpoints: - Spend analytics/BI (links to VS-28); expense monitoring (links to VS-34.3); FP&A (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: Finance/Contingent Workforce Mgr compile spend analytics: by category (security/janitorial/promodizer/etc.), by location, by agency, by GL/cost center (links to VS-34.3), vs budget (links to VS-33) and prior period; compute cost per unit (per store, per sqm, per shift)

Analyze drivers and opportunities: rate vs benchmark (W3213), overtime/premium spend, idle/overstaffing, SLA-credit recovery, category consolidation, demand-management (reduce unnecessary contingent hours), insource/outsource (W3231)
Execute cost actions: renegotiate rates (W3213), consolidate suppliers, eliminate low-value spend, enforce PO compliance (W3217); track savings vs target and report to finance/exec

fields.Participants: Safety Mgr (links to VS-24), Risk & Insurance (links to VS-26), Legal, User Dept, Agency, Contractor

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Respond to incident" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "Investigate root cause" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: thorough investigation and contract terms (W3213/W3214); operational: reporting culture and analytics (W3225)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liability-attribution risk**: Disputed responsibility for incident/cost; mitigated by thorough investigation and contract terms (W3213/W3214)
- **Underreporting risk**: Minor incidents unreported, masking systemic issues; mitigated by reporting culture and analytics (W3225)
System Touchpoints: - HSE/incident (links to VS-24); insurance/claims (links to VS-26); legal (links to VS-100); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Respond to incident: first aid/medical, secure scene, document (photos, witness statements, time/location), notify Safety and agency; for serious injury/fatality, notify DOLE per VS-24.1 (occupational accident reporting) and preserve evidence; contractor-worker medical care is agency/ECC responsibility

Investigate root cause: Safety/Agency joint investigation, determine cause (worker error, equipment, process, environment), corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), assign responsibility (BuildRight vs contractor vs shared); document for HSE metrics (links to VS-24.1) and DOLE

Manage claims and recovery: contractor workers' compensation via agency/ECC; third-party/property-damage claims via BuildRight/contractor insurance (W3214); subrogation where third party at fault; legal matter for disputes (links to VS-100); reserve for loss (W3277)

fields.Participants: Loss Prevention Mgr (links to VS-23), Security, Legal, User Dept, Agency, HR
fields.Trigger: Loss event (links to VS-23); anomaly; tip/complaint

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "methodology" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with agency for worker removal/cooperation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-register of "register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: shared industry watchlists and agency contractual obligation; operational: agency involvement and legal guidance
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recidivism risk**: Problematic worker re-deployed by agency; mitigated by shared industry watchlists and agency contractual obligation
- **Boundary-violation risk**: BuildRight directing discipline during investigation; mitigated by agency involvement and legal guidance
System Touchpoints: - Loss prevention (links to VS-23); CCTV/access (links to VS-23.2); legal (links to VS-100); risk register (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Loss Prevention (links to VS-23.1) detect and triage: shrinkage anomaly, cash-handling discrepancy (links to VS-08/VS-81), asset theft (links to VS-35/VS-99), timesheet/deliverable fraud (W3220), collusion with BuildRight employees; initiate investigation per VS-23 methodology

Investigate: evidence collection (CCTV links to VS-23.2, access logs, transaction data), interview (with agency present — not direct BuildRight discipline), coordinate with agency for worker removal/cooperation; preserve chain of custody for potential criminal/civil action (links to VS-100)

Resolve: recovery (civil/criminal per PD 1612 (Anti-Fencing Law) for stolen goods), agency chargeback/disqualification (W3216), tighten controls (access, supervision, screening W3223), feed lessons to risk register (links to VS-21.2) and scorecard (W3225)

fields.Participants: Labor Compliance Mgr, HR (links to VS-19), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Finance, Legal
fields.Trigger: Misclassification finding (W3226); 5-month/6-month statutory thresholds; strategic insource decision (W3231)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify conversion triggers" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-calculate of "calculate and pay back-wages/benefits/13th-month/SIL per NLRC/DOLE order where…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Manage headcount boundary" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: structuring discipline (W3211) and early conversion; operational: boundary management and reserves
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mass-conversion risk**: Systematic misclassification → large back-pay and headcount shock; mitigated by structuring discipline (W3211) and early conversion
- **Budget-disruption risk**: Unplanned conversions strain budget; mitigated by boundary management and reserves
System Touchpoints: - Employee master/payroll (links to VS-19); workforce planning (links to VS-19.3); finance/budget (links to VS-17.4/VS-33)
Time Estimate: - 1–3 weeks per conversion (longer for contested/back-pay cases)

steps.activity: Labor Compliance/HR identify conversion triggers: workers approaching statutory engagement-duration thresholds (6-month constructive-regularization per W555 context), misclassification findings (W3226), strategic insourcing (W3231), performance-based conversion offer; compute back-pay/ benefits liability (W3215)

HR/Recruitment (links to VS-19.1) execute conversion: offer regular employment, onboard as employee (master data, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG enrollment, contract), calculate and pay back-wages/benefits/13th-month/SIL per NLRC/DOLE order where applicable; recover from agency per indemnity where contractually liable

Manage headcount boundary: maintain ratio guardrails (W3209), update workforce plan (links to VS-19.3), ensure converted roles reflected in headcount/budget (links to VS-33/VS-17.4); monitor for future triggers

fields.Participants: Contingent Workforce Mgr, HR, User Dept, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Change (links to VS-33)
fields.Trigger: Strategic review (W3209); performance/compliance failure; cost benchmarking; capability-build

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Build business case for insource/outsource" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review, KPI baseline and tracking, lessons-learned, update workforce plan" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: phased transition and overlap; operational: legal structuring and engagement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transition-disruption risk**: Service gap or quality dip during handover; mitigated by phased transition and overlap
- **Conversion-dispute risk**: TUPE-equivalent obligations and worker claims; mitigated by legal structuring and engagement
System Touchpoints: - Workforce planning (links to VS-19.3); finance (links to VS-17.4); change/portfolio (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: Build business case for insource/outsource: total-cost comparison (W3209), capability/quality/control considerations, risk (W3226), strategic alignment, capital/transition cost (W3188 for facilities, VS-99 for technology); obtain approval per authority matrix

Plan and execute transition: for insource — recruit/hire (links to VS-19.1), train (links to VS-19.4), build capability, convert where applicable (W3230), terminate outsource contract (W3216); for outsource — select agency (W3210), structure contract (W3211), transfer function/knowledge, redeploy employees
steps.r: Contingent Workforce Mgr / HR / User Dept

steps.activity: Stabilize and measure: post-transition review, KPI baseline and tracking, lessons-learned, update workforce plan (links to VS-19.3) and category strategy (W3209); manage any residual legal/employee-relations issues (links to VS-84)

fields.Participants: CHRO, Contingent Workforce Mgr, HR (links to VS-19), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Strategy (links to VS-33), User Depts
fields.Trigger: Annual strategic cycle; major operating-model change

workflows.name: Workforce Composition Strategy & Integrated Workforce Planning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconcile with budget" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor composition KPIs quarterly" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-525 (ensure controlled execution — Contingent Workforce Performance, Risk & Spend Analytics (PA-98.3).)
- operational: integrated planning and ratio KPIs; operational: capability strategy (links to VS-19)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Composition-imbalance risk**: Over-contingent or over-employee in either direction; mitigated by integrated planning and ratio KPIs
- **Capability-gap risk**: Future skills not built; mitigated by capability strategy (links to VS-19.4)
System Touchpoints: - Strategic plan/portfolio (links to VS-33); workforce planning (links to VS-19.3); FP&A (links to VS-17.4); BI (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: CHRO/Strategy (links to VS-33) build integrated workforce plan: total workforce (employees + contingent + outsourced functions), composition targets by function/location, build/buy/borrow decisions, capability/skills strategy, future-state for growth (10–15 new stores/year) and automation (links to VS-30); reconcile with budget (links to VS-33/VS-17.4)

Finance model total cost of workforce: employee comp+benefits (links to VS-19.2), contingent spend (W3227), outsourced-function cost (W3231), management overhead, compliance/risk premium; scenario analysis (growth, downturn, automation)

Approve and cascade composition strategy; integrate into VS-19 hiring plan, VS-34 procurement plan, and VS-33 strategic plan; monitor composition KPIs quarterly (employee-to-contingent ratio, contractor conversion rate, insource/outsource balance) and adjust
